title: Validate Windows CNG RSA private components and fix xtask clock-skew and gate-index tests
goal: Fix the remaining three pre-existing Windows test failures blocking 0.21.47 native integration and Windows origin/main: (1) Windows CNG BCryptImportKeyPair ignores d during import and reconstructs it from p and q, so corrupting private field 0 was accepted by platform_rsa_rejects_malformed_non_rsa_and_corrupt_private_keys; add pure-std 4096-bit Zeroizing component validation and reserve private_blob capacity upfront; (2) anchor database_pin_rejects_missing_wrong_dirty_stale_and_future_inputs to the recorded commit timestamp so git.exe invocation latency on Windows cannot push now() past the clock-skew check; (3) update workspace_test_count_rejects_empty_cargo_suite_before_production_build from gate-4.log to gate-6.log after the two advisory/all-features gates shifted indices.
